summary: Interpretation recorded for the leadership-transfer experiment (CheckRun ffa0ec9302fc43f89664310bd5b9a332, exit 0). Findings: LeadershipTransferToServer aimed at the demoted non-voter returned nil within the same millisecond while the old leader was already Follower and the named destination only Candidate; the destination never led during the eight second watch; the control with a voter destination returned nil and that voter did lead. Four of five declared comparisons hold; the third is violated by a valid witness because the field I asserted (old_leader_still_leader == false) means the old leader was seen leading at some point in the watch, which it satisfied by re-winning the fresh election - my declaration, not the data. I recorded the account as conditional on the immediate window, with the source path for each part (no suffrage filter on the explicit destination while pickServer filters; TimeoutNow making any destination a candidate without pre-vote; voters adopting the higher term and stepping down before the suffrage rejection; the success result coming from the lost-leadership branch without checking the destination), asserted the scoped defect claim - a caller naming a destination that cannot lead receives an indistinguishable success while the cluster suffers an unrequested leadership interruption - and kept the recovery as explicit counterevidence that limits the phrasing, together with the sampling and single-run limits. No further experiment was submitted, since the remaining allocation would not cover executing and interpreting another receipt.
